verses.text: Mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro ari umwami w’Ubuperesi, Uhoraho kugira ngo ashitse ijambo yari yaravuze aciye kuri Yeremiya, akangura umutima wa Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi na we atanga mu bwami bwiwe itegeko ryanditswe rivuga ngo:
“Ibi ni vyo Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi avuze: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru, yampaye ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi kandi yantoranije ngo ndamwubakire Ingoro i Yerusalemu i Buyuda.
Umuntu wese wo mu bantu biwe ari muri mwebwe naduge i Yerusalemu i Buyuda yubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ari yo Mana iri i Yerusalemu. Imana yiwe ibane na we.
Kandi abantu bose babana n’abo bacitse kw’icumu babahe inzahabu, ifeza, n’ubundi butunzi n’imikuku, hamwe n’ivyo umuntu ashikana avyishakiye ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu.’ ”
Nuko abakuru b’imiryango y’Abayuda n’Ababenyamini, n’abaherezi hamwe n’Abalewi, n’umuntu wese Imana yakoze ku mutima, bitegurira kuduga ngo bubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu.
Ababanyi babo bose babafashisha ibikoresho vy’ifeza, vy’inzahabu, ubundi butunzi n’imikuku, n’izindi ngabire z’agaciro, vyiyongera ku mashikanwa abantu batanze n’umutima ubikunze.
Vyongeye, umwami Kuro asohora ibikoresho vyakora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze abikuye i Yerusalemu akabishira mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana ciwe.
Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi yari yarabitumye Mitiredati umuzezwabintu, na we arabiharura abishikiriza Sheshubazari umuganwa w’i Buyuda.
Uru ni urutonde hamwe n’ibitigiri vyavyo: amasiniya y’inzahabu mirongo itatu, amasiniya y’ifeza igihumbi, amapanu y’ifeza mirongo ibiri n’icenda,
ibikombe vy’inzahabu mirongo itatu, ibikombe bitobito vy’ifeza amajana ane na cumi, n’ibindi bikoresho igihumbi.
Vyose na vyose, vyari ibikoresho ibihumbi bitanu n’amajana ane vy’inzahabu n’ifeza. Sheshubazari azana ivyo vyose ari kumwe n’abavuye mu kinyago batashe bavuye i Babiloni baja i Yerusalemu.

headings.text: Kuro afasha abatwawe nk’inyagano gusubira iwabo

verses.text: Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abantu bo muri iyo ntara baduze bavuye mu kinyago, abo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yari yarajanye nk’inyagano i Babiloni. Abo ni bo bagarutse i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda, umwe wese aca aja mu gisagara c’iwabo.
Bari baherekejwe na Zerubabeli, Yesuwa, Nehemiya, Seraya, Reyelayiya, Moridekayi, Bilushani, Misipari, Bigivayi, Rehumu na Bayana. Urutonde rw’abagabo bo mu Bisirayeli ni uru:
Abakomoka kuri Paroshi ni ibihumbi bibiri n’ijana na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Shefatiya, ni amajana atatu na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Ara ni amajana indwi na mirongo indwi na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu (biciye kuri Yesuwa na Yowabu) ni ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana umunani na cumi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Elamu ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Zatu ni amajana icenda na mirongo ine na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Zakayi ni amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Bani ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ine na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Bebayi ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Azigadi ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Adonikamu ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu na batandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Bigivayi ni ibihumbi bibiri na mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Adini ni amajana ane na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Ateri, biciye kuri Hezekiya ni mirongo icenda n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Bezayi ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Yorahi ni ijana na cumi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Hashumi ni amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Gibari ni mirongo icenda na batanu.
Abantu b’i Betelehemu ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abantu b’i Netofa ni mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Ab’i Anatoti ni ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Ab’i Azimaveti ni mirongo ine na babiri.
Ab’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, Kefira na Beroti ni amajana indwi na mirongo ine na batatu.
Ab’i Rama n’i Geba ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri n’umwe.
Ab’i Mikimashi ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Ab’i Beteli n’i Hayi ni amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Ab’i Nebo ni mirongo itanu na babiri.
Ab’i Magibishi ni ijana na mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Ab’i Elamu handi ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri.
Abakomoka kuri Lodi, Hadidi na Ono ni amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri na batanu.
Ab’i Yeriko ni amajana atatu na mirongo ine na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Senaya ni ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itatu.
Abaherezi: Abakomoka kuri Yedaya biciye mu muryango wa Yesuwa ni amajana icenda na mirongo indwi na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Imeri ni igihumbi na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Pashuri ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo ine n’indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni igihumbi na cumi n’indwi.
Abalewi: abakomoka kuri Yesuwa biciye kuri Kadimiyeli mu ruvyaro rwa Hodaviya ni mirongo indwi na bane.
Abacuraranzi: abakomoka kuri Asafu ni ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Abarinzi b’irembo ry’urusengero: abakomoka kuri Shalumu, Ateri, Talumoni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobayi ni ijana na mirongo itatu n’icenda.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro: abakomoka kuri Ziha, Hasufa, Tabawoti,
Kerosi, Siyaha, Padoni,
Lebana, Hagaba, Akubu,
Hagabu, Shamulayi, Hanani,
Gideli, Gahari, Reyaya,
Rezini, Nekoda, Gazamu,
Uza, Paseya, Besayi,
Asina, Meyunimu, Nefusimu,
Bakibuki, Hakufa, Harihuri,
Baziluti, Mehida, Harisha,
Barikosi, Sisera, Tema,
Neziya na Hatifa.
Abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo: abakomoka kuri Sotayi, Hasofereti, Peruda,
Yayala, Darukoni, Gideli,
Shefatiya, Hatili, Pokereti-Hazebayimu na Ami.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro n’abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo bose hamwe ni amajana atatu na mirongo icenda na babiri.
Aba bakurikira baduze bavuye mu bisagara vya Teli-Melahi, Teli-Harusha, Kerubi, Adoni na Imeri, ariko ntibashoboye kwerekana ko imiryango yabo ikomoka ku Bisirayeli.
Abakomoka kuri Delaya, Tobiya na Nekoda ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Mu baherezi: abakomoka kuri Habaya, Hakozi na Baruzilayi (umugabo yari yarongoye umukobwa wa Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi agaca yitirirwa iryo zina nyene).
Abo ni bo barondeye intonde za ba sekuruza b’imiryango yabo, ariko ntibashobora kuzironka, maze baca bakurwa mu gikorwa c’ubuherezi nk’abahumanye.
Umukuru w’intara, aca abategeka kutarya ivyejejwe gushika haje umuherezi agasiguza Uhoraho akoresheje Urimu na Tumimu.
Igitigiri c’abantu bose cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu,
ukuyemwo ibihumbi indwi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’indwi vy’abagurano n’abaguranokazi; kandi bari bafise abagabo n’abagore b’abaririmvyi amajana abiri.
Bari bafise amafarasi amajana indwi na mirongo itatu n’atandatu, inyumbu amajana abiri na mirongo ine na zitanu,
ingamiya amajana ane na mirongo itatu na zitanu n’indogoba ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri.
Bamaze gushika ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, bamwe bo mu bakuru b’imiryango batanga amashikanwa bavyishakiye kugira ngo aze yubake Ingoro y’Imana aho yahora.
Bakurikije uburyo bafise, batanze mu bubiko bw’iki gikorwa ingero dariki ibihumbi mirongo itandatu n’imwe z’inzahabu, ingero mina ibihumbi bitanu z’ifeza, n’impuzu z’abaherezi ijana.
Abaherezi, Abalewi, abarinzi b’irembo, abaririmvyi n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, bari kumwe n’abandi bantu hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose baja kuba mu bisagara vyabo.
Ukwezi kw’indwi gushitse, Abisirayeli bamaze gushika mu bisagara vyabo, abantu bakoranira hamwe i Yerusalemu nk’umuntu umwe.

Maze Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki na bagenziwe b’abaherezi na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli n’abo bari bafatanije batangura kwubaka igicaniro c’Imana y’Abisirayeli kugira ngo bashobore gushikana ibimazi bituririrwa kuri co, nk’uko vyari vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose umuntu w’Imana.

Naho bari bafise ubwoba kubera gutinya amahanga yari abakikije, barubatse igicaniro kw’itanguriro ryaco baca bagitangirako ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, babishikanira Uhoraho , vyaba ivyo mu gitondo canke ivyo ku mugoroba.
Maze nk’uko vyari vyanditswe, bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago, batanga igitigiri c’ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro nk’uko vyasabwa ku musi ku musi.

Inyuma y’ivyo, baca bashikana ibimazi vyo guturirwa bisanzwe bitangwa, ibimazi vyo mu mboneko z’ukwezi n’ibimazi vy’imisi mikuru y’ Uhoraho yose yategetswe, hamwe n’ivyazanywe n’umuntu wese ashikaniye Uhoraho avyishakiye.
Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi batangura gushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, naho itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ritari bwashirweho.

Nuko baha amahera abubatsi n’ababaji, baha abantu b’i Sidoni n’i Tiro ivyokurya, ibinyobwa n’amavuta kugira ngo bazane ibiti vy’amasederi babikuye i Libani gushika i Yopa, babicishije mu kiyaga, nk’uko vyari vyaremewe n’umwami Kuro w’i Buperesi.

Mu kwezi kwa kabiri kw’umwaka ugira kabiri kuva bashitse i Yerusalemu ahari Ingoro y’Imana, Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki na benewabo basigaye b’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abari bagarutse i Yerusalemu bavuye mu kinyago, batangura igikorwa. Bashiraho Abalewi bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga ngo bakurikirane igikorwa co gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Yesuwa n’abahungu biwe n’abo bavukana, Kadimiyeli n’abahungu biwe (bakomoka kuri Hodaviya), abahungu ba Henadadi n’abahungu babo n’abo bavukana, bose bakaba bari Abalewi, barifatanya kugira ngo bashobore gukurikirana abakozi bariko barakora ku Ngoro y’Imana.

Abubatsi bamaze gushiraho itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , abaherezi bambaye ya myambaro yabo bafise n’inzamba, n’Abalewi, bene Asafu bafise n’ivyuma bisama, bafata ibibanza vyabo ngo bahimbaze Uhoraho , nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.

Baririmbira Uhoraho indirimbo zo gutazira no gushima bati: “Ni mwiza; urukundo akunda Abisirayeli rwamaho ibihe bidashira.” Maze abantu bose barasemerera cane bahimbaza Uhoraho , kuko itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ryari rimaze kwubakwa.

Ariko benshi mu baherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’imiryango bashaje, bari barabonye Ingoro ya mbere, bararira cane babonye itanguriro ry’iyo Ngoro yindi ririko rirubakwa, mu gihe abandi na bo bariko baravuza urwamo kubera umunezero.
Nta n’umwe yashobora gutandukanya akamo k’umunezero n’ijwi ry’abarira, kuko abantu basemerera cane rwose. Kandi urwamo rwarumvikana umuntu akiri kure.
Abansi b’Abayuda n’Ababenyamini bumvise ko abahora ari inyagano bariko barubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli,

baraza bashikira Zerubabeli n’abakuru baserukira imiryango bababwira bati: “Reka tubafashe kwubaka kuko na twebwe dusenga Imana yanyu, kandi twamye tuyishikanira ibimazi kuva mu gihe ca Esaruhadoni umwami w’i Ashuri, ari we yatuzanye hano.”

Ariko Zerubabeli, Yesuwa n’abandi bose bo mu bakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli babishura bati: “Nta co dusangiye mu kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yacu. Ni twebwe twenyene tuzoyubakira Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, nk’uko umwami Kuro, umwami w’i Buperesi, yadutegetse.”
Nuko amahanga yari abakikije akura hasi ngo ace intege Abayuda abatera n’ubwoba ngo ntibashishikare kwubaka.

Barondera abakozi b’ubwo bwami babaha impera kugira ngo babagwanye. Ivyo vyatumye imigambi yabo idatera imbere mu gihe cose umwami Kuro w’i Buperesi yamaze ari ku ngoma gushika no ku ngoma y’umwami Dariyusi w’i Buperesi.
Igihe Ahasuwerusi yari akija ku ngoma, abansi b’Abayuda banditse ikete ryo kwagiriza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu.

Maze mu misi ya Ahasuwerusi umwami w’i Buperesi, Bishulamu, Mituredati, Tabeyeli n’abandi bari bafatanije bandikira Ahasuwerusi. Iryo kete ryari ryanditswe mu rurimi rw’Icarameya hanyuma bararisobanurira umwami.
Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo na Shimushayi umunyamabanga bandikira umwami Aritazeruzi ikete ryo kwagiriza ab’i Yerusalemu rivuga riti:

Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo na Shimushayi umunyamabanga, hamwe n’abandi dufatanije, abacamanza n’abakuru batwara abantu baturuka i Tiriporisi, i Buperesi, i Babiloni hamwe n’abantu bava i Ereki n’i Susa, ari bo Banyalamu.
Barongera kandi barungika n’indamukanyo z’abantu umwubahwa Ashurubanipali yatwaye akabashira mu gisagara c’i Samariya n’ahandi muri iyo ntara iri mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate.
Iyi ni ikopi y’iryo kete banditse. Ku mwami Aritazeruzi, Bivuye ku basavyi bawe, abantu bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate:

Umwami yomenya neza ko Abayuda baduze baza iwacu bavuye iwanyu bashikiye i Yerusalemu kandi bariko barubaka ca gisagara kigarariza kandi gikora ibibi. Bariko barasanura impome basubiramwo amatanguriro.
Vyongeye, umwami akwiye kumenya ko ico gisagara nicubakwa inzitiro zaco zigasanurwa, ata matagisi, ivyagerewe umwami canke ikori bizosubira gutangwa, kandi ubutunzi bw’umwami buzogira ingorane.
None rero kubera yuko twubaha ikirimba kandi akaba atari vyiza kureka umwami ngo akengerwe, twandikiye ubu butumwa umwami kugira ngo tubimumenyeshe,

hanyuma hakorwe amatohoza mu vyanditswe bivuga ivyabaye ku ngoma z’Abakwitangiye imbere. Muri ivyo vyanditswe uzosanga ico gisagara ari igisagara c’abagarariji, bakunda gutera umudugararo ku bami n’abatwara intara, abantu bamye bagarariza kuva kera. Ni co gituma ico gisagara cari carasambuwe.
Tumenyesheje umwami ko ico gisagara nicubakwa inzitiro zaho zigasanurwa, ata co uzoba ugisigaranye mu ntara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate.
Umwami yishura ati: Kuri Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo, Shimushayi umunyamabanga n’abandi bose mufatanije baba i Samariya n’ahandi hose mu ntara yo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate: Ndabaramukije.
Ikete mwaturungikiye ryarasomwe kandi ryahinduriwe mu rurimi imbere yanje.
Naratanze itegeko maze hakorwa amatohoza, dusanga ko ico gisagara gifise kahise ko kugarariza abami kandi ko camye kibamwo imigumuko.
I Yerusalemu harigeze kugira abami bakomeye batwaye intara yose yo mu buseruko bw’uruzi Efurate, amatagisi, amashikanwa yo kwisaba n’ayandi makori vyahabwa bo.
None rero nimutumeko abo bantu mubategeke guhagarika ico gikorwa, kugira ngo ico gisagara ntigisubire kwubakwa kugeza ntanze irindi tegeko.
Mwitonde kugira ngo ntimufate minenerwe ico kibazo. Ni igiki cotuma iyi ngorane ikura, ikageramira inyungu z’ubwami?

Iyo kopi y’ikete ry’umwami Aritazeruzi rigisomewe Rehumu na Shimushayi umunyamabanga n’abo bari bafatanije, baca bihuta kuja ku Bayuda bari i Yerusalemu babategeka guhagarika ku nguvu ivyo bariko barakora.
Nuko igikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu kiba kirahagaze kugeza mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi w’i Buperesi ari ku ngoma.

headings.text: Abandi babagwanije ku ngoma ya Ahasuwerusi na Aritazeruzi

verses.text: Muri ico gihe Hagayi na Zakariya mwene Ido, abavugishwa n’Imana, baravugishwa babwira Abayuda bari i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu mw’izina ry’Imana y’Abisirayeli, ari yo yari ibarongoye.
Maze Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli na Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki barahaguruka ngo bongere gusanura Ingoro y’Imana y’i Yerusalemu. Kandi abavugishwa b’Imana bari kumwe na bo, ngo babafashe.

Ico gihe nyene Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi n’abo bari bafatanije baja aho bari barababaza bati: “Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo gusubira kwubaka iyi Ngoro no gusanura aha hantu?”
Bongera barababaza bati: “Ni ba nde bariko barubaka iyi nzu?”
Ariko kubera inyonga z’Imana yabo zari kuri abo barongozi b’Abayuda, ntibahagaritse igikorwa kugeza bishikiriye Dariyusi na we akabishura kandi ikete ryiwe rikabashikira.
Iyi ni ikopi y’ikete Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi n’abari kumwe na bo, abakuru bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, barungikiye umwami Dariyusi.
Raporo bamurungikiye ni yo y’iyi: Ku mwami Dariyusi, Turabaramukije bivuye ku mutima.

Umwami yomenya neza ko twagiye mu ntara y’i Buyuda, ku Ngoro y’Imana nkuru. Abantu bariko barayubakisha amabuye maninimanini bashirako n’imbaho mu bihome. Ico gikorwa kiriko kirabandanya ata ngorane kandi kiriko kiratera kija imbere kirongowe na bo.
Twarabajije abarongozi tuti: “Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro no gusanura aho hantu?
Kandi twarababajije n’amazina, kugira ngo tuyakwandikire umenye amazina y’abarongozi babo.”

Iyi ni yo nyishu baduhaye: “Turi abasavyi b’Imana y’ijuru n’isi, kandi turiko turasanura Ingoro yari yarubatswe mu myaka myinshi yarenganye, imwe umwami ahambaye wa Isirayeli yari yarubatse akayirangiza.

Maze kubera ko ba sogokuruza bashavuje Imana yo mw’ijuru, vyatumye ibagabura mu maboko ya Nebukadineza Umukaludaya, umwami w’i Babiloni, ari we yasambuye iyi Ngoro agatwara abantu nk’inyagano i Babiloni.
Ariko, mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro umwami w’i Babiloni agiye ku ngoma, umwami yatanze itegeko ryo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana.

Yarongeye akura mu ngoro y’i Babiloni ibikoresho vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza vyahoze mu Ngoro y’Imana, ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze abikuye mu Ngoro i Yerusalemu akabijana mu ngoro i Babiloni. Nuko umwami Kuro abiha umuntu yitwa Sheshubazari, uwo yari yagenye ngo abe umukuru w’intara,
kandi aramubwira ati: ‘Fata ibi bikoresho ubijane ubisubize mu Ngoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu, kandi ize yubakwe mu kibanza yahozemwo.’
Nuko uwo Sheshubazari araza ashiraho amatanguriro y’Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu. Kuva ico gihe kugeza uwu musi iracubakwa ntirahera.

None rero nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, nihagirwe itohoza mu vyanditswe vyabaye biri i Babiloni kugira ngo murabe koko ko umwami Kuro yoba yaratanze iryo tegeko ryo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu. Maze umwami ace aturungikira ico azoba ategetse ku vyerekeye ico kibazo.”
Umwami Dariyusi araheza atanga itegeko, avuga ko barondera mu bitabu bivuga ivyabaye, vyari mu bubiko bw’i Babiloni.
Hatorwa umuzingo mu munara wa Ekubatana mu ntara ya Medi, uwo na wo ukaba wari wanditswemwo ngo: Icibutso:

Mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Kuro ari ku ngoma yasohoye itegeko ryerekeye Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu rivuga ngo: “Ingoro nisubire kwubakwa ahantu Abayuda bahora batangira ibimazi, kandi amatanguriro yayo niyubakwe. Izoba ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’ubwaguke,
yubakishijwe n’imirongo ibiri y’amabuye maninimanini n’umurongo umwe w’imbaho. Amahera yose akenewe azova mu butunzi bw’i bwami.

Kandi, ibikoresho vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana, ivyo Nebukadineza yanyaze abikuye mu ngoro i Yerusalemu akabitwara i Babiloni, bize bisubizwe mu bibanza vyavyo mu Ngoro i Yerusalemu, bishirwe mu Nzu y’Imana.”

Maze umwami Dariyusi aca arungika ubu butumwa: Nuko rero, Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi na we nyene, hamwe n’abandi bakuru batwara iyo ntara, mwigire kure y’aho hantu.
Ntimuhungabanye iyubakwa ry’iyo Ngoro y’Imana. Nimureke umukuru w’Abayuda n’abatware babo basubire bayubake mu kibanza yahozemwo.

Vyongeye, ntanze itegeko ryerekeye ivyo muzokorera abo bakuru b’Abayuda bijanye no kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana: Amahera yose bazokoresha aze arihwe avuye mu butunzi bw’i bwami, buva mu matagisi atozwa mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, kugira ngo ico gikorwa ntigihagarare.

Ibikenewe vyose: amashuri, impfizi z’intama hamwe n’imyagazi y’intama bitangwa nk’ibimazi vyo guturirwa bishikanirwa Imana yo mw’ijuru, ingano, umunyu, umuvinyu n’amavuta, nk’uko bisabwa n’abaherezi i Yerusalemu, baze babihabwe imisi yose ata na kimwe kibuze,
kugira ngo bashobore gushikanira ibimazi bihimbara Imana yo mw’ijuru bongera basengera umwami n’abahungu biwe kugira ngo bamererwe neza.
Ikindi, ntegetse ko nihagira umuntu n’umwe arenga kuri iri tegeko, bazoce bakura inkingi mu nzu yiwe bayimumanikeko kandi inzu yiwe ize ihindurwe umusaka.

Imana, yo yagenye ko izina ryayo riba aho hantu, ize ikure ku ngoma umwami wese canke ihanga ryose rizoramvurira ukuboko guhindura iri tegeko canke gusambura iyi Ngoro y’i Yerusalemu. Jewe Dariyusi nshinze iki cagezwe. Nigishirwe mu ngiro uku nyene gishinzwe ata guca i ruhande.
Hanyuma, kubera ico cagezwe c’umwami Dariyusi, Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate na Shetari Bozenayi n’abo bari bafatanije bagishira mu ngiro ata co bahinduye.

Nuko Abarongozi b’Abayuda babandanya kwubaka kandi bagenda batera imbere barongowe n’ubutumwa bw’uwavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi na Zakariya, wo mu ruvyaro rwa Ido. Barangiza kwubaka iyo Ngoro nk’uko Imana y’Abisirayeli yategetse kandi nk’uko Kuro, Dariyusi na Aritazeruzi, abami b’i Buperesi, bari babitegetse.
Ingoro y’Imana yahejeje kwubakwa ku musi ugira gatatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari, mu mwaka ugira gatandatu umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma.
Nuko Abisirayeli, abaherezi, Abalewi n’abandi bose bari baravuye mu kinyago, bahimbaza umusi mukuru wo gushikiriza Imana Ingoro yayo banezerewe.

Mu gushikiriza iyo Ngoro y’Imana batanga amashuri y’inka ijana, impfizi z’intama amajana abiri, imyagazi y’intama amajana ane, hamwe n’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha vy’Abisirayeli bose kigizwe n’amasuguru y’impene icumi n’abiri, imw’imwe ku muryango wose w’Abisirayeli.
Baca bashiraho abaherezi mu mice yabo n’Abalewi mu migwi yabo ngo bakore igikorwa c’Imana i Yerusalemu, nk’uko vyari vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Mose.
Ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere, Abavuye mu kinyago bahimbaza Pasika.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi bari bihumanuye bejejwe neza. Abalewi bakererera umwagazi w’intama wa Pasika abavuye mu kinyago bose, benewabo b’abaherezi hamwe na bo nyene ubwabo.

Nuko Abisirayeli bari bagarutse bavuye mu kinyago barawurya, hamwe n’abo bose bari bitandukanije n’ibikorwa bihumanya vyakorwa n’abanyamahanga babana na bo kugira ngo barondere mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.

Bamara imisi indwi bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro kandi banezerewe kuko Uhoraho yari yabujuje umunezero mu guhindura ivyiyumviro vy’umwami w’i Ashuri, kugira ngo abafashe mu gikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana, Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Inyuma y’ivyo, ku ngoma ya Ahasuwerusi umwami w’i Buperesi, haza Ezira mwene Seraya, Seraya mwene Azariya, Azariya mwene Hilukiya,
Hilukiya mwene Shalumu, Shalumu mwene Sadoki, Sadoki mwene Ahitubu,
Ahitubu mwene Amariya, Amariya mwene Azariya, Azariya mwene Merayoti,
Merayoti mwene Zerahiya, Zerahiya mwene Uzi, Uzi mwene Buki,
Buki mwene Abishuwa, Abishuwa mwene Finehasi, Finehasi wene Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri mwene Aroni umuherezi mukuru.

Uwo Ezira aduga avuye i Babiloni. Yari umwigisha yize neza Ivyagezwe vya Mose, ivyo Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli yari yaratanze. Umwami yari yamuhaye ivyo yari yamusavye vyose, kuko ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe kwari kuri we.
Bamwe mu Bisirayeli, harimwo n’abaherezi, Abalewi, abaririmvyi, abarinzi b’irembo n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, na bo nyene baraduga i Yerusalemu mu mwaka ugira indwi umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma.
Ezira ashika i Yerusalemu mu kwezi kugira gatanu kw’umwaka ugira indwi uwo mwami ari ku ngoma.
Yari yavuye i Babiloni ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, ashika i Yerusalemu ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa gatanu, kuko ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana kwari kuri we.
Kandi Ezira yari yariyeguriye kwiga no kwitondera Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho no kwigisha ivyo yihanikirije n’amabwirizwa yatanze mu Bisirayeli.
Iyi ni ikopi y’ikete umwami Ahasuwerusi yahaye Ezira umuherezi n’umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe, umuntu yanonosoye ivyerekeye amabwirizwa n’amategeko Uhoraho yahaye Abisirayeli:
Jewe Aritazeruzi, umwami w’abami, Kuri Ezira umuherezi, umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yo mw’ijuru: Ndakuramukije.
Ubu rero ntegetse ko Umwisirayeli wese ari mu bwami bwanje, harimwo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bipfuza kuja i Yerusalemu bajanye nawe, bashobora kugenda.
Urungitswe n’umwami hamwe n’abahanuzi biwe indwi ngo uje gutohoza neza ivyerekeye i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ku bijanye n’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yanyu, biri mu maboko yawe.
Vyongeye, uze ujane ifeza n’inzahabu ivyo umwami n’abahanuzi biwe bashikaniye Imana y’Abisirayeli iba i Yerusalemu bavyishakiye,
hamwe n’ifeza n’inzahabu ushobora kuronka mu ntara y’i Babiloni, hamwe n’amashikanwa yose abantu n’abaherezi bazotanga ku bw’Ingoro y’Imana yabo iri i Yerusalemu.
Muri ayo mahera, uze uguremwo amashuri y’inka, impfizi z’intama n’imyagazi y’intama, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa, maze ubishikane ku gicaniro kiri mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu i Yerusalemu.
Wewe na benewanyu b’Abayuda mushobora gukoresha ico cose muzobona ko kibereye ifeza n’inzahabu bizosigara, mwisunze ivyo Imana yanyu igomba.
Uze utereke imbere y’Imana y’i Yerusalemu ibikoresho vyose wahawe vyo gutazirisha Imana mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu.
Muze mukure mu nzu y’ubutunzi bw’umwami ivyo muzokenera gukoresha ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yawe.
Ubu rero, jewe umwami Aritazeruzi, ntegetse abazezwabintu bose bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate ngo batange ivyo Ezira umuherezi, umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yo mw’ijuru, azobasaba vyose,
gushika kw’italanto ijana z’ifeza, ingero koru ijana z’ingano, ingero batu ijana z’umuvinyu, ingero batu ijana z’amavuta ya elayo hamwe n’umunyu wose ukenewe.
Ikintu cose Imana yo mw’ijuru yategetse, kize gikorwe uko nyene gitegetswe ata gihazemwo ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yo mw’ijuru. Ni iki cotuma dukwegera uburake bwayo umwami n’abahungu biwe?

Mumenye kandi ko mutemerewe kwaka itagisi, ishikanwa ryo kwisaba canke ikori umuherezi n’umwe canke Abalewi, abaririmvyi, abarinzi b’irembo, abakozi bo mu Ngoro canke abandi bose bakora muri iyo Ngoro.

Nawe, Ezira, ukoresheje ubwenge usanganywe bw’Imana yawe, uze utoranye abacamanza bakuru n’abandi basanzwe kugira ngo bacire imanza abantu bose bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate; abantu bose bazi Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe. Kandi uze uyigishe abatayazi bose.
Umuntu wese atazokwumvira Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe n’amategeko y’umwami aze ahanishwe igihano co gupfa, kwirukanwa mu gihugu, kunyagwa itongo, canke gushirwa mw’ibohero.
Nihashimwe Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, we yashize ku mutima w’umwami guhezagira Ingoro y’ Uhoraho iri i Yerusalemu muri ubu buryo

kandi yangiriye ubuntu bungana gutya imbere y’umwami n’abahanuzi biwe n’abandi bashizwe hejuru bo mu bwami bwiwe. Kubera ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho Imana yanje kwari kuri jewe, narumvise ko ndemye, maze ndegeranya abantu barongora abandi bava muri Isirayeli ngo badugane nanje.
Aba ni bo bakuru b’imiryango hamwe n’abo bandikanywe, twaduganye tuvuye i Babiloni ku ngoma y’umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Finehasi ni Gerishomu. Mu bakomoka kuri Itamari ni Daniyeli. Mu bakomoka kuri Dawidi ni Hatushi
yakomotse kuri Shekaniya; mu bakomoka kuri Paroshi ni Zakariya n’abagabo ijana na mirongo itanu bari banditswe hamwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu ni Eliyehowenayi mwene Zerahiya, yari kumwe n’abagabo amajana abiri.
Mu bakomoka kuri Zatu ni Shekaniya mwene Yahaziyeli, n’abagabo amajana atatu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Adini ni Ebedi mwene Yonatani, n’abagabo mirongo itanu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Elamu ni Yeshaya mwene Ataliya, n’abagabo mirongo indwi bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Shefatiya ni Zebadiya mwene Mikayeli, n’abagabo mirongo umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomotse kuri Yowabu ni Obadiya mwene Yehiyeli, n’abagabo amajana abiri na cumi n’umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Shelomiti mwene Yosifiya, n’abagabo ijana na mirongo itandatu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bebayi ni Zakariya mwene Bebayi, n’abagabo mirongo ibiri n’umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Azigadi ni Yohanani mwene Hakatani, n’abagabo ijana na cumi bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Adonikamu ni abanyuma muri uwo muryango; amazina yabo akaba yari Elifeleti, Yeweli na Shemaya, n’abagabo mirongo itandatu bari kumwe na bo.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bigivayi ni Utayi na Zakuri, n’abagabo mirongo indwi bari kumwe na bo.
Ndabakoraniriza ku mugezi utemba uja Ahava, aho hantu tuhamara imisi itatu. Maze kuraba neza mu bantu no mu baherezi, nsanga nta Mulewi n’umwe arimwo.
Nuko ntoranya Eliyezeri, Ariyeli, Shemaya, Elunatani, Yaribu, Elunatani, Natani, Zakariya na Meshulamu, bari abarongozi, na Yoyaribu na Elunatani, bari abantu b’incabwenge,

maze ndabarungika kwa Ido, umutware w’i Kasifiya. Ndababwira ivyo baza kubwira Ido na benewabo, abakozi bo mu Ngoro bari i Kasifiya, kugira ngo baturungikire abakozi bo kudufasha igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Kubera ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana yacu kwari kumwe natwe, baturungikira Sherebiya, umuntu afise ugutahura, wo mu bakomotse kuri Mahuli mwene Lewi, Lewi mwene Isirayeli, n’abahungu n’abavukanyi ba Sherebiya, abagabo icumi n’umunani;
na Hashabiya, hamwe na Yeshaya wo mu bakomotse kuri Merari, n’abavukanyi biwe n’abahungwabo, abagabo mirongo ibiri.
Bazana n’abandi amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri b’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, urwego Dawidi n’abaganwa biwe bari barashizeho ngo bafashe Abalewi. Bose barandikwa amazina.

Aho nyene ku nkombe z’umugezi uja muri Ahava, menyesha abantu ko bisonzesha, kugira ngo twicishe bugufi imbere y’Imana yacu duheze tuyisabe iduhe kugira urugendo rwiza twebwe n’abana bacu, n’ivyo dutunze vyose.

Kuko vyaranteye isoni gusaba umwami ingabo n’abagendera ku mafarasi bo kudukingira abansi bodutegera mu nzira, kandi twari twarabwiye umwami ko ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana yacu kuri kumwe n’umuntu wese amuhanze amaso, ariko ko uburake bwiwe buri ku bamutera ibitugu.
Nuko turisonzesha twinginga Imana yacu ku bw’ivyo, na yo yishura ugusenga kwacu.
Maze ntoranya abaherezi icumi na babiri bo kuturongora, bari kumwe na Sherebiya, Hashabiya n’abandi icumi bo muri benewabo,
ndabapimira za feza n’inzahabu zo gushikana na vya bikoresho umwami, abahanuzi biwe, abatware biwe n’Abisirayeli bose bari ngaho bari batangiye Ingoro y’Imana yacu.
Ndabapimira italanto amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu z’ifeza, ibikoresho bikozwe mw’ifeza bingana n’italanto ijana, n’izindi ijana z’inzahabu,
ibikombe mirongo ibiri vy’inzahabu vy’agaciro kangana n’ingero dariki igihumbi, n’ibikoresho bikozwe mu mwakaka usenye neza bifise agaciro nk’inzahabu.
Ndababwira nti: “Mwebwe n’ibi bikoresho mwejerejwe Uhoraho . Ifeza n’inzahabu ni ishikanwa ryahawe Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza n’umutima ubikunze.
Mubizigame neza kugeza mubipimye mugeze mu vyumba vy’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu imbere y’abakuru b’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli.”
Nuko abaherezi n’Abalewi bakira izo feza n’inzahabu n’ivyo bikoresho vyejejwe vyari vyateguriwe kujanwa mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu i Yerusalemu.

Ku musi ugira icumi na kabiri w’ukwezi kwa mbere tuva kuri wa mugezi uja muri Ahava tuja i Yerusalemu. Ukuboko kw’Imana yacu kwari kuri twebwe, maze iratuzigama iturinda abansi n’abambuzi mu rugendo rwose.
Maze dushika i Yerusalemu, tuharuhukira imisi itatu.

Ku musi ugira kane, mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu, dupima za feza n’inzahabu na vya bikoresho vyejejwe tubiha Meremoti mwene Uriya, umuherezi. Eliyazeri mwene Finehasi yari kumwe na we, hamwe n’Abalewi Yozabadi mwene Yesuwa na Nowadiya mwene Binuwi.
Vyose vyarapimwe biraharurwa, maze ibipimo vyose birandikwa muri ico gihe.

Maze abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago bashikanira Imana y’Abisirayeli ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro: amashuri y’inka icumi n’abiri kubw’Abisirayeli bose, impfizi z’intama mirongo icenda na zitandatu, imyagazi y’intama mirongo indwi n’indwi n’amasuguru y’impene cumi n’abiri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha. Ivyo vyose vyari ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro bishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Kandi bashikiriza ya mategeko y’umwami abishikira b’umwami n’abakuru b’intara bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, na bo baca bafasha abantu baterera n’Ingoro y’Imana.

headings.text: Urutonde rw’abakuru b’imiryango bagarukanye na Ezira

verses.text: Ivyo vyose bimaze gukorwa, abarongozi baza aho ndi baravuga bati: “Abisirayeli, harimwo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, ntibitandukanije n’abanyamahanga babana mu gihugu hamwe n’imigenzo yabo mibi birenze urugero, nk’iy’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abaperizi, Abayebusi, Abamoni, Abanyamowabu, Abanyegiputa n’Abamori.

Abagabo b’Abisirayeli babatoyemwo abakobwa babagira abagore babo kandi babakwera n’abahungu babo na bo. Ivyo vyatumye haba ikivange c’ubwoko bwera n’ayo mahanga. Kandi abarongozi n’abacamanza ni bo babaye aba mbere gukora ico kizira.”
Numvise ivyo, nitabagurirako umwambaro wanje n’ikoti, nishikura umushatsi n’ubwanwa, hanyuma nicara hasi mbabaye cane.

Abantu bose bajugumizwa n’amajambo y’Imana y’Abisirayeli baza aho ndi barankikuza kubera ico kibi abagarutse bava mu kinyago bakoze. Maze nguma ngaho nicurikiriye kugeza igihe co gutanga ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Nuko hageze gutanga ikimazi co ku mugoroba, mpaguruka aho nari nicurikiririye, umwambaro wanje n’umutamana wanje vyatabutse, nca mpfukama hasi nduza amaboko Uhoraho Imana yanje
ndaheza ndasenga nti: “Ewe Mana yanje, maramajwe cane kandi nteterejwe no kukurangamiza, kuko ivyaha vyacu ari vyinshi kugeza n’aho bidusumba kandi igicumuro cacu cashitse mw’ijuru.

Kuva mu misi ya ba sogokuruza gushika n’ubu, ukugabitanya kwacu kwamye ari kwinshi. Kubera ivyaha vyacu, twebwe n’abami bacu n’abaherezi bacu bagerewe inkota no kuba inyagano, kunyagwa ivyacu no gucurangurizwa mu maboko y’abami b’amahanga, nk’uko bimeze uwu musi.

Ariko noneho, Uhoraho Imana yacu, muri kano kanya gato, ahejeje kutugirira ubuntu mu kudusigariza amasigarira no kuduha ikibanza gikomeye mu ngoro yiwe yera, ku bw’ivyo Imana yacu ikaba itumurikiye kandi iduhaye agahengwe mu buja bwacu.

Naho turi abagurano, Imana yacu ntiyaduhebeye mu buja bwacu. Yatweretse ukugira neza kwayo imbere y’abami b’i Buperesi: Yadusubije ubuzima bushasha ngo dusubire kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yacu no gusanura aho yasambutse, kandi yaduhaye uruzitiro rwo kudukingira i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Ariko ubu, ewe Mana yacu, twovuga iki inyuma y’ivyo? Ko twakengereye amabwirizwa yawe

watanze ucishije mu bavugishwa bawe aho wavuga uti: Igihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo mucegukire ni igihugu candujwe n’abantu bakibamwo. Bacujuje ibihumanya vyabo kuva ku mpera gushika ku yindi ku bw’ibikorwa vyabo bibi.

Nuko rero, ntimuze mukoshe abakobwa banyu ku bahungu babo canke ngo musabire abahungu banyu abakobwa babo. Ntimuze mwigere mugiranira amasezerano y’ubugenzi na bo, kugira ngo mube abanyenkomezi kandi murye ivyiza vyo mu gihugu muze mukirage abana banyu nk’umugabane w’ibihe bidashira.
Ivyadushitseko ni ingaruka y’ibikorwa vyacu bibi n’ukugabitanya kwacu gukomeye, ariko n’ubwo biri uko, Mana yacu waduhanye buhoro ugereranije n’ivyo twakoze kandi waduhaye amasigarira nk’aya.
None twosubira kugarariza amabwirizwa yawe tugahana abageni na ya mahanga yakora ibibi vy’akaburarugero? Mbega ntivyotuma uraka bigatuma uturandura, ntudusigire amasigarira canke n’uwocika kw’icumu?

Ewe Uhoraho , Mana y’Abisirayeli, uragororotse! Uyu musi twasigaye nk’amasigarira. Turi hano imbere yawe dutsinzwe n’ivyo twakoze, naho ata woshobora guhagarara imbere y’inyonga zawe ku bw’ivyaha vyiwe.”

headings.text: Isengesho rya Ezira ku bubakanye n’abanyamahangakazi

verses.text: Ezira agisenga yatura, arira yubamye imbere y’Ingoro y’Imana, abantu benshi b’Abisirayeli, abagabo, abagore n’abana, bakoranira aho ari. Na bo nyene bararira cane.

Nuko Shekaniya mwene Yehiyeli, umwe wo mu bakomoka kuri Elamu, abwira Ezira ati: “Ntitwabaye abizigirwa imbere y’Imana yacu mu kurongora abagore b’abanyamahangakazi dukuye mu mahanga adukikije. Ariko naho bimeze uko, haracariho ivyizigiro ku Bisirayeli.

Ubu rero, nimuze dusezeranire imbere y’Imana yacu, twemere kwirukana abo bagore bose n’abana babo, nk’uko wewe nyakwubahwa ubiduhanura n’abandi bose bahindira agashitsi imbere y’amabwirizwa y’Uhoraho Imana yacu. Kandi tubikore twisunze ivyagezwe.
Haguruka; iki kibazo kiri mu maboko yawe. Natwe turagushigikiye, komera kandi ubikore.”
Nuko Ezira aca ava hasi arahiza abakuru mu baherezi n’Abalewi n’Abisirayeli bose ngo bakore ivyo vyavuzwe. Bose bararahira.

Maze Ezira aca ava imbere y’Ingoro y’Imana aja mu cumba ca Yehohanani mwene Eliyashibu. Ari ngaho, ntiyariye ikintu na kimwe kandi ntiyanyoye n’amazi, kuko yabandanije agandaye kubera ubuhemu abavuye mu kinyago bagize.
Nuko babimenyesha mu Buyuda hose n’i Yerusalemu ngo abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago bakoranire hamwe i Yerusalemu.

Umuntu wese atashoboye kuboneka mu misi itatu yaca anyagwa itongo ryiwe, nk’uko vyari vyashinzwe n’abatware hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango, kandi na we nyene ubwiwe agaca akurwa mw’ikoraniro ry’abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago.

Mu misi itatu, abagabo bose b’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini bari bakoraniye i Yerusalemu, maze ku musi wa mirongo ibiri w’ukwezi kw’icenda, abantu bose bari bicaye mu kibuga c’Ingoro y’Imana, batetemera kubera iyo ngorane hamwe rero n’imvura nyinshi.
Nuko Ezira umuherezi arahaguruka arababwira ati: “Ntimwabaye abizigirwa; mwarongoye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi, mwongereza ku bibi Abisirayeli bari barakoze.
None rero nimwaturire Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza icaha canyu, kandi mukore ivyo agomba. Mwitandukanye n’abanyamahanga mubana n’abagore mwazanye b’abanyamahangakazi.”
Ikoraniro ryose ririshura n’ijwi rirenga riti: “Uvuze ukuri! Turakora nk’uko uvuze.

Ariko hano hari abantu benshi kandi ni mu gihe c’imvura; kubera ivyo ntidushobora guhagarara hanze. Ikigeretse kuri ivyo, ibi ntibishobora gutunganywa ku musi umwe canke ibiri, kuko twakoze icaha gikomeye mu gukora ivyo.

Abatware bacu nibabikore mu gishingo c’ikoraniro ryose. Maze umuntu wese wo mu bisagara vyacu yarongoye umunyamahangakazi mu gihe kinaka cemejwe, azoze azananye n’abakuru n’abacamanza bo mu gisagara kimwe cose, kugira ngo uburake bw’inkazi bw’Imana yacu bwatewe n’iyi ngorane bushobore kutuvako.”
Yonatani mwene Asaheli na Yahizeya mwene Tikuva ni bo bonyene bagwanije iyo ngingo, bashigikiwe na Meshulamu na Shabetayi Umulewi.

Nuko abatahutse bavuye mu kinyago bakora nk’uko bagiriwe inama. Ezira umuherezi atoranya abagabo bari abakuru b’imiryango, umw’umwe mu muce w’umuryango, kandi abagabo bose babavuga mu mazina. Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’icumi baricara ngo bige ivyo bintu,
kandi kugeza ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere baraheza kwihweza ivyerekeye abagabo bose bari barongoye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi.
Mu bakomotse ku baherezi, aba bakurikira ni bo bari bararongoye abanyamahangakazi: Mu bakomoka kuri Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki, n’abavukanyi biwe ni Mayaseya, Eliyezeri, Yaribu na Gedaliya.
(Bose basezerana mu ndahiro kwirukana abagore babo, no gutanga impfizi y’intama ivuye mu mukuku ngo ibe ikimazi co kwisaba ku bw’icaha cabo.)
Mu bakomoka kuri Imeri ni Hanani na Zebadiya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Harimu ni Mayaseya, Eliya, Shemaya, Yehiyeli na Uziya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pashuri ni Eliyowenayi, Mayaseya, Ishimayeli, Netaneli, Yozabadi na Elasa.
Mu Balewi ni Yozabadi, Shimeyi, Kelaya ari we Kelita, Petahiya, Yuda na Eliyezeri.
Mu baririmvyi ni Eliyashibu. Mu barinzi b’irembo ni Shalumu, Telemu na Uri.
Mu bakomotse ku bandi Bisirayeli: Mu bakomoka kuri Paroshi ni Ramiya, Iziya, Malikiya, Miyamini, Eliyazeri, Malikiya na Benaya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Elamu ni Mataniya, Zakariya, Yehiyeli, Abudi, Yeremoti na Eliya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Zatu ni Eliyowenayi, Eliyashibu, Mataniya, Yeremoti, Zabadi na Aziza.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bebayi ni Yehohanani, Hananiya, Zabayi na Atilayi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Meshulamu, Maluki, Adaya, Yashubi, Sheyali na Yeremoti.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu ni Adina, Kelali, Benaya, Mayaseya, Mataniya, Bezaleli, Binuwi na Manase.
Mu bakomoka kuri Harimu ni Eliyezeri, Ishiya, Malikiya, Shemaya, Shimeyoni,
Benyamini, Maluki na Shemariya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Hashumi ni Matenayi, Matata, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremayi, Manase na Shimeyi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Mayadayi, Amuramu, Uweli,
Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi,
Vaniya, Meremoti, Eliyashibu,
Mataniya, Matenayi na Yayasu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Binuwi ni Shimeyi,
Shelemiya, Natani, Adaya,
Makinadebayi, Shashayi, Sharayi,
Azareli, Shelemiya, Shemariya,
Shalumu, Amariya na Yosefu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Nebo ni Yeyiyeli, Matitiya, Zabadi, Zebina, Yadayi, Yoweli na Benaya.
Abo bagabo bose bari bararongoye abanyamahangakazi kandi bamwe muri bo bari bafitaniye abana n’abo bagore.
